paper_title: Search for an axion-like particle in radiative $J/ψ$ decays
notes: BESIII search for ALP in radiative J/psi decays, a->gamma gamma. Mass range 0.165-2.84 GeV/c^2 (1.65e8 to 2.84e9 eV). Limits on g_agamma. The only explicit numerical coupling value in text is g_agamma > 3e-4 GeV^-1 excluded at m_a ~ 0.25 GeV (2.5e8 eV). Full exclusion curve is shown in Fig 6 but no table of (mass, coupling) values is provided, so only the single text-quoted point is extracted.
